_comment: THE ONLY hand-written per-project file of the studio standard. JSON, not .psd1: read with [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p,[Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ConvertFrom-Json (STD-ENC-09). Binds ValeraScreenshot (studio app #3) to STANDARD.md. Free placeholders here; derived fields (Exe, AppData, EnvPrefix, Cer, UninstallKey, Mutex, Namespace) are a formula of AppId - never written by hand.

Deviations.Reason: ValeraScreenshot is a screenshot ANNOTATOR. The colours in Annotate.cs / OverlayForm.cs / ShareForm.cs are annotation DATA (the user-chosen pen/marker palette, per-annotation Color, the Word-2024 duotone glyph ink/accent), not theme. They are intrinsic to the drawing tools. Theme/UI colours DO live in Ui.cs (Theme class). Centralizing tool colours into Ui.cs would be wrong.
Deviations.Cost: The E2 grep flags Color.FromArgb in the drawing layer. Bounded to Annotate/OverlayForm/ShareForm; theme stays single-sourced in Ui.cs.

Deviations.Reason: OverlayForm MUST be AutoScaleMode.None and map 1:1 to the virtual screen in PHYSICAL pixels (PerMonitorV2). DPI auto-scaling would rescale the frozen capture overlay and break pixel-exact selection, the magnifier and annotation placement - the app's whole reason to exist (native-resolution capture). Every other Form (Settings/About/Share) sets AutoScaleMode.Dpi.
Deviations.Cost: One Form (OverlayForm) is exempt by design. Named and bounded.

Deviations.Reason: The single-instance mutex literal lives in src\Ident.cs (STD-IDENT-01: the single identity source); App.cs references Ident.Mutex. C3 pre-dates the Ident.cs pattern (which does not yet exist in the etalon) and greps App.cs for the literal string. The literal IS present, in Ident.cs, and matches the bind (ValeraScreenshot_SingleInstance_{A17D}).
Deviations.Cost: C3 needs the numeric-id reconciliation on the studio side to look in Ident.cs. Until then it reads as a fork; it is not.

Deviations.Reason: RESOLVED 2026-07-21 (kept as a record; Check=null so nothing is skipped). The product is the author's personal brand. The last carrier of the old organisation was the SHARED studio certificate; the owner ran tools\studio_percert.ps1 -Apply (publisher identity became per-app in the studio normalizer, agreed core 5 -> 5) and tools\newcert.ps1 -Apply (personal certificate CN=Pavlo Isaiev minted, pin moved, .cer exported). ValeraScreenshot now signs with its own certificate; the studio's published app keeps the old one. The former LS-DEV-06 (declared G2 drift of sign.ps1 + deploy\trust_cert.cmd while the normalizer wiring was pending) is closed by the same act - G2 must be green with NO deviation from here on.
